repairs.rootCause: A live P7 acceptance suite lived outside clean-room/tests/*.test.mjs, so no gate executed it and its delegation assertion had drifted from the enforced error contract.
repairs.repair: Relocated into the mandatory test glob with its assertion reconciled to the enforced amplification-blocked contract.

repairs.rootCause: The gate required evidence committed inside the very head it names, a self-referential condition that no commit can satisfy, so P15.2 could never close.
repairs.repair: Binding replaced with an exact reviewed-inventory digest plus one-for-one per-file records, which rejects any later edit, addition or removal.
